description: This file defines a package 'flowrate' providing tools for monitoring and limiting data stream flow rates, including a Monitor struct with methods for updating transfer stats, limiting transfer rates, and retrieving status.

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: A struct for monitoring and controlling data transfer rates, including tracking bytes transferred, transfer rate samples, and implementing rate limiting.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: A struct representing the current status of a Monitor, including transfer rates, progress, and remaining bytes.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Monitor with specified sample rate and window size for rate calculations.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Records the transfer of n bytes and updates internal statistics.

methods.name: IO
methods.description: Wraps io.Reader/io.Writer calls, updating transfer stats.

methods.name: Done
methods.description: Marks transfer as finished, disables further updates, and returns total bytes transferred.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns current transfer status including rates, progress, and remaining bytes.

methods.name: Limit
methods.description: Restricts transfer to a specified rate, optionally blocking until allowed transfer size is available.

methods.name: SetTransferSize
methods.description: Sets total expected transfer size for progress calculations.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Internal method to update transfer statistics based on bytes transferred.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets sample-specific counters for the next measurement interval.

methods.name: waitNextSample
methods.description: Sleeps until the next sampling interval, used in rate limiting.
